answer.rationale: The incumbent’s refusal to reopen price makes renewal incompatible with the mandated 18% reduction, while the low-cost quote meets it. Before committing, verify the low-cost vendor’s actual onboarding, delivery, quality, capacity, and continuity record against the incumbent’s proven integration stability. Because the line has only 6% headroom, any switch should be phased with explicit delivery and quality gates rather than treated as a broad unguarded rollout.
